neighbours.label: A two-letter mixed-case token, lower case then capital, chiefly the unit abbreviations dB, kB, mA, kW and mL; all-capital (MB, GB) and all-lower-case (cm, mm) units in the same slot stay quiet.
fire: The signal dropped by 6 dB past the hill.
Each photo is about 90 kB on the server.
The small sensor draws 5 mA when awake.
This heater is rated at 3 kW in winter.
Add 50 mL of water to the flask.
A noisy room can reach 70 dB by evening.
The email attachment was only 12 kB in size.
The LED needs about 15 mA to glow.
quiet: The signal dropped by 6 percent past the hill.
Each photo is about 90 MB on the server.
The small sensor draws 5 watts when awake.
This heater is rated at 3 GW in winter.
Add 50 cm of tubing to the flask.
A noisy room can reach 70 people by evening.
The email attachment was only 12 GB in size.
The LED needs about 15 mm to fit.

notes: Probes: ' mA' 0.74, ' kW' 0.39, ' mL' 0.64 against ' MB' 0.004, ' cm' 0.007. Three-letter ' kHz' read 0.15, and 'Ah' in mAh 0.004. Base64 chunks in the top examples ('xC', 'xE') are not covered by this test.
